heading.title: Services under the Union and the States

article.title: Power to make regulations as to conditions of service of members and staff of the Commission
article.content:
318Power to make regulations as to conditions of service of members and staff of the Commission

Article 318 · Part XIV
In the case of the Union Commission or a Joint Commission, the President and, in the case of a State Commission, the Governor 1*** of the State may by regulations—
(a)determine the number of members of the Commission and their conditions of service; and
(b)make provision with respect to the number of members of the staff of the Commission and their conditions of service:
ProvisoProvided that the conditions of service of a member of a Public Service Commission shall not be varied to his disadvantage after his appointment.

1 The words "or Rajpramukh" omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956, s. 29 and Sch. (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).
